Ennyinyonnyola y'okugatta Host (Host binding)
127.0.0.1 (oba localhost): kompyuta eno yokka y'esobola okuggulawo ekifo ky'omukutu.
0.0.0.0: ewuliriza ku mikutu gyonna ebyuma ebirala ku LAN yo bisobole okugattibwa.

Entegeka eza bulijjo
- Ku kompyuta yokka: host = 127.0.0.1
- Essimu/tabuleeti ku Wi-Fi y'emu: host = 0.0.0.0, olyoke oggulewo http://<PC_LAN_IP>:<PORT>/

Amagezi ag'okugonjoola obuzibu
- Essimu ne PC biteekwa okuba ku mukutu gw'awaka ogw'emu (weewale Wi-Fi y'abagenyi oba eyawuddwa).
- Ebyuma ebiri ebweru bwe biba tebisobola kugattibwa, kkiriza TCP eyingira ku pooti erondeddwa mu Windows Firewall.
- Pooti 80 bw'eba ekontana ne ppulogulaamu endala, kyusa odde ku pooti endala (okugeza 8091).
- Kozesa http:// (so si https://) okuggyako ng'otaddeko TLS reverse proxy yo.

Obubaka bw'obukuumi
Bw'okozesa 0.0.0.0, omuntu yenna ali ku kkubo ly'omukutu eryakkirizibwa asobola okutuuka ku kifo ky'omukutu.
Kozesa emikutu egyeesigika n'obukugira bwa firewall.

  sudo setcap cap_net_raw,cap_net_admin=eip {real_executable}

Oba ddukanya Session Sniffer n'obuyinza bwa root:
  sudo -E env PATH=$PATH python3 -m session_sniffer
